asset.name: ContextIndicator
asset.description: The compact explanation of which files, records, memories, tools, and scopes are currently available to the agent, with inspection and removal for each.

requires.reason: Entries wrap without resizing the surrounding surface.

suggests.reason: Inspecting an entry in place suits dense contexts; a list view may prefer navigation.

rationale: Directly addresses the most common source of user confusion with agents: not knowing what the agent can actually see. Making context legible and removable turns an opaque system into a controllable one.
